research_question: Can coverage-constrained selective regression preserve aircraft and duration access while maintaining calibrated fuel-burn uncertainty under temporal, route and data-quality shift?

primary_hypotheses.test: At matched overall coverage, the constrained policy reduces the maximum duration and eligible-aircraft coverage gap relative to unconstrained risk ranking.
Duration-Mondrian split-conformal intervals improve worst-duration coverage without increasing mean interval width by more than 25 percent relative to global split conformal.
Natural zero-ADS-B intervals have materially higher absolute error than intervals with at least 51 positions.

data_roles.training: chronologically earlier flights; fuel-model fitting only
data_roles.risk_training: later disjoint flights; absolute-error model fitting only
data_roles.calibration: later disjoint flights; conformal quantiles and fixed policy thresholds only
data_roles.validation: later disjoint flights; model selection and exploratory ablations only
data_roles.confirmation: post-freeze, untouched flights from a later period or independent operator/geography

model_comparisons_when_raw_data_are_avai: temporal sequence model with an identical split and feature availability
generalization_tests: receiver-region or operator holdout when identifiers and permissions allow
uncertainty_methods: aircraft-Mondrian split conformal with minimum sample fallback
importance-weighted split conformal under measured covariate shift

statistics.multiple_testing: Holm correction within each reported subgroup family

claim_rules: No confirmatory claim may be made from September or October 2025 because those labels informed development.
No live reference fuel may be displayed before delayed ground truth is legitimately available.
No external-validity claim may be made from a route split alone.
The fuel estimator and the uncertainty calibrator must be distinguished in every unseen-aircraft result.
All exclusions, failed runs and deviations from this protocol must be reported.
